name: Basic worker check
description: Worker must be online and unlocked

name: Worker context status check
description: Worker without context is allowed; otherwise worker context must be allocatable

name: Routing country match
description: Routing country, when required, must come from worker context

name: Worker capability check
description: Project support gates generic tasks; SDK event tasks use explicit worker event capability
content: ((taskEventCode == null || taskEventCode == '') && supportsProject == true) || ((taskEventCode != null && taskEventCode != '') && supportsEvent == true)

name: Worker load check
description: Worker-supported project count must stay below 10
